content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the current recruitment by IIT Roorkee is Research Associate-I. This is a contract-based government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate-I at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-I position in the latest IIT Roorkee recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Associate-I posts at IIT Roorkee is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly at the venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should arrive well in advance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Research Associate-I at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Research Associate-I must hold a PhD in Biotechnology / Lifesciences / Biomedical Engineering/ Equivalent from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-I post will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000 per month along with 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Roorkee Research Associate-I recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Research Associate-I at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I position primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by document verification of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Research Associate-I post be located?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I position will be located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, as per the details provided for the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original documents, self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate, and extra passport-size photographs.
